context.title: San Diego County Taxpayers Association: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Fallbrook Union Elementary School District — Measure K (Fallbrook Union Elementary School District School Facilities Bond Measure)

positions.statement: Mark Kersey (San Diego County Taxpayers Association President and CEO) signed the argument in favor of Fallbrook Union Elementary School District Measure K in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
